[[Beacon of the Unseen]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[White Mantle Ritualist (ritualist)|White Mantle Ritualist]]s in [[Kryta]] during the [[War in Kryta]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Channeling Magic]])
:[[Armor]] +5 (while Health is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance and [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item with the same stats. Inscriptions on replicas provide core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
*One of the following [[Channeling Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Channeling Focus]] from collector [[Danira]]
**[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Focus]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription#Hail_to_the_King|Hail to the King]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Channeling Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Channeling Focus]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Spirit Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
